theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (A : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective (L.comp A) → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ ((L.comp A) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ((L.comp A) (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) ≤ ‖L‖ ^ n * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (A (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))))) ∧ ∀ (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet B → (∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → InjOn F B → MeasurableSet (F '' B) ∧ Measurable (Function.invFunOn F B) ∧ (∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (F '' B)), p y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict B), p (F x)) ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable h (μHE[n].restrict (F '' B)) → (IntegrableOn h (F '' B) μHE[n] ↔ IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) * h (F x)) B) ∧ ∫ y in F '' B, h y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in B, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) * h (F x)
